description:
**🚩 Important reminder:**
The spots are limited because we want to make sure that everyone gets a chance to speak and the group size stays comfy. If you RSVP "Going," your spot is guaranteed, but if your plans change, **please update** me or change your RSVP to "Not Going," so we can pass the spot to someone on the waitlist. **Repeated no-shows** may result in being prevented from RSVPing for future events. Thanks for helping us keep things smooth! 🙏🏼

Auckland Public Speaking is free to come along to.
Meetup does charge us a fee to keep the group running, so if you enjoy the evening and would like to chip in **koha-style** to help cover it, it would be genuinely appreciated. Details will be shared on the night.

**Join us for an evening of meaningful talks!**

We believe in fostering heartfelt connections and personal growth by sharing our life experiences. Come along and practice public speaking in an environment where kindness and authenticity are at the heart of everything we do. Everyone will have an opportunity to talk at every event. You're encouraged to take the stage and share your thoughts, you're also welcome to just watch and absorb the atmosphere, if that's more comfortable for you too.

* **Intermediate speakers** looking for another forum to practice and improve amongst a like-minded community.
* **Advanced speakers** looking to polish their skills, experiment with ideas and approaches, and impart their wisdom to others!

title: Finance Essentials for Self-Employed IT Pros
location: 74 Governor Fitzroy Place, Auckland CBD, Auckland 1010, New Zealand, Auckland
description:
From Developer to Business Owner: What Every Self-Employed IT Professional Should
Know

**Speaker Introduction**
[Michelle Dong](https://www.linkedin.com/in/michelle-kejia-dong/), Manager at one of the Mid-Tier accounting firm, specialising in
accounting, tax, and business advisory services. She works closely with self-employed
professionals, contractors, and small business owners, helping them navigate tax
obligations, business structures, cash flow management, and financial compliance.
Michelle is passionate about making accounting and tax practical, accessible, and
relevant for business owners so they can focus on what they do best.

**Session Description**
Many IT professionals move into contracting, freelancing, or consulting for greater
flexibility and earning potential, but with that independence comes new
responsibilities.
This session will cover the key accounting, tax, and business fundamentals that every
self-employed IT professional should understand, including:
• Choosing the right business structure
• GST and income tax obligations
• Provisional tax and ACC
• Claiming business expenses correctly
• Managing cash flow and tax payments
• Common mistakes made by contractors and freelancers
• Practical tips to stay compliant and financially organised
Whether you're considering self-employment, have recently started contracting, or have
been running your own business for years, this session will provide practical insights
and actionable tips to help you manage the financial side of your business with
confidence.

title: Agentic Engineering Day New Zealand
description:
Hi all,

We’re excited to bring [Agentic Engineering Day to New Zealand](https://www.agenticbuild.day/) this October 21–22, 2026 in Auckland.

Agentic Engineering Day is an independent, community-driven conference for software engineers, architects, builders, and curious minds exploring what it really means to work with AI systems in practice. From agents and emerging standards like MCP, SKILLS, to orchestration, evaluation, governance, observability & tracing, security, memory & context management and infrastructure - this is about the messy, real-world challenges of moving Cognitive Architectures out of the lab and into hardened, reliable production systems.

Whether you're experimenting with your first agent or scaling complex AI systems, this is a space to learn, share, and help shape the future of the local industry - together.

**Note:** Make sure to register to secure your seat! There is limited space available.

**[Agentic Engineering Day](https://www.agenticengineering.day/) (formerly Agentic Build Day)** is a paid event with community-priced tickets. Join us and support!

**Call for papers OPEN!**

If you're building agentic systems, shipping them into production, or pushing the boundaries of what autonomous AI can do, we want to hear about it.

Share what you're learning with the community and let’s build the future of agentic systems together.

Submissions are open now → https://www.agenticengineering.day/

title: JuniorDev Auckland Meet
location: 125 The Strand, Parnell, Auckland 1010, New Zealand, Auckland
description:
We’re happy to announce the next **JuniorDev Auckland event**!

Join us for an evening of learning and connection as we hear from our speakers and the experiences they’ll be sharing.

**Important Note for Attendees:**

* **Please note of the new location for the event: [Directions to Serko House](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1M8Jt_-5DmBABSiNnaDpCpNiHNfxMRCICI1eRBjne-08/edit?tab=t.0) (Just 2 mins away from Xero)**

**Talk 1: Finding Joy After AI: An Inside Out Look at How We Work by Kevin Meneses**
Inspired by Disney and Pixar's Inside Out films, this (pre-recorded) talk uses their premise as a framework to explore what team survey data reveals about AI adoption, productivity, and working hours, offering practical ways to thrive in an AI-assisted workflow.

**A bit about Kevin:**

* Kevin is a Junior Software Engineer at Fergus who transitioned into engineering from the Customer Support team after completing a full stack developer programme.

**Talk 2: Building AI without Losing Our Values by**
**Lauren Peate**
AI is here to stay – hype, copyright theft, data worker mistreatment, environmental harm, and all. If you care about people and the planet but also need to understand new tech, what can you do? I’ll recommend a middle ground – using AI in features and workflows without compromising our values. Combining my own experience with insights from our original research with hundreds of global developers, I’ll share examples of how to use this tech with care.

**A bit about Lauren:**

* Lauren Peate is a data nerd who cares about people. She’s founder and CEO of Multitudes, which turns engineering metrics into a tool for continuous improvement – in AI, engineering productivity, developer experience, and more. Through her career, she’s worked with a wide range of organizations, from Fortune 500 tech companies in San Francisco to startups in the Middle East. Previously on a PhD track, she started her career conducting independent research through a Fulbright grant.
